rationales: A ratio compares quantities and does not represent a phosphate bond.
A proportion expresses equality between ratios, not a bond.
A tilde (~) indicates the high-energy covalent bond between phosphate groups.
A colon is used to separate quantities or ratios, not to indicate this bond.
Carbohydrates provide about 4 kilocalories per gram, not 3.
One gram of carbohydrate provides about 4 kilocalories.
Two kilocalories per gram is too low for carbohydrates.
Five kilocalories per gram is not the standard energy value for carbohydrates.
The expected number of bioelements is not 13.
The expected number of bioelements is not 14.
The expected number of bioelements is not 15.
The textbook count of bioelements is 16.
Viroids lack a protein coat and are not composed of protein.
Viroids consist only of a short strand of RNA.
Viroids contain RNA rather than DNA.
Viroids are not composed of carbohydrate.
Genus is a taxonomic rank above species.
Order is a higher taxonomic rank, not the basic unit.
Species is the basic unit of biological classification.
Class is a higher taxonomic rank, not the basic unit.
Golgi is associated with the discovery of the Golgi apparatus, not lysosomes.
Rudolf is not the scientist credited with discovering lysosomes.
Rene de Duve discovered lysosomes.
De-Lamarck is not credited with discovering lysosomes.
Golgi bodies do not have their own DNA.
Ribosomes do not have their own DNA.
Mitochondria contain their own DNA.
Lysosomes do not have their own DNA.
Apoptosis is programmed, regulated cell death rather than accidental cell death.
Necrosis is accidental death of cells and living tissues.
Sinopsis is not the term for accidental cell death.
Regeneration is the replacement or regrowth of cells and tissues.
Metabolism does not derive from a Greek word meaning division.
The Greek-derived word refers to change.
Deduction is not the meaning of the Greek root of metabolism.
Matter is not the meaning of the Greek root of metabolism.
Oxidation is the loss of electrons from an atom or molecule.
Reduction is the gain of electrons.
Anabolism is the building of complex molecules, not electron loss.
Catabolism is the breakdown of molecules, not the definition of electron loss.
The average lifespan of a red blood cell is about 120 days.
A lifespan of 130 days is not the standard average.
A lifespan of 180 days is too long for the usual average.
A lifespan of 90 days is shorter than the usual average.
August Weismann developed ideas about heredity and germ cells but did not discover meiosis in 1876.
Golgi is known for the Golgi apparatus, not the discovery of meiosis.
Walther Flemming described mitosis, not the 1876 discovery of meiosis.
Oscar Hertwig discovered meiosis in 1876 while studying sea urchin eggs.
Emil Fischer proposed the lock-and-key model of enzyme action.
Wilhelm is not credited with proposing this model.
Calvin is not credited with proposing this model.
Daniel Koshland proposed the induced-fit model, not the lock-and-key model.
Chlorophyll a is the principal photosynthetic pigment.
Chlorophyll b is an accessory pigment.
Chromoplasts are plastids, not a photosynthetic pigment.
Carotenoids are accessory pigments, not the principal one.
Lipids provide about 9 kilocalories per gram, not 4.
Six kilocalories per gram is below the standard energy value for lipids.
One gram of lipid provides about 9 kilocalories.
3.8 kilocalories per gram is not the standard energy value for lipids.
